title: 第3章 杀猪过年第4章 癔想
content_zh:
还有一天就要过年了，大概是为了给年关增加点气氛，这两日天降暴雪，滴水成冰。
严寒之下，村里那些卧床等死的人，老天爷没让他们浪费本就不多的口粮，一天就死了三个。
那些死了亲人的家庭，都只简单敷衍地哭两声，然后用草席一卷，就埋进了乱葬岗。
穷人命贱，就像野草一样，每到冬天就要死一茬，大家早就麻木了。
不过，二狗子大伯一家，今天却是其乐融融。
在县城学武的堂兄回来了，堂弟上学的私塾也早就放假了。
那头二狗子养了两年的大黑猪，终于在今天寿终正寝，被杀掉过年。
这头猪毛重83斤，洗刮干净之后，同内脏一起还有50斤肉，足够全家过一个肥年了。
二狗子今天也没再去捡柴，跟着忙上忙下，烧水刮毛，翻肠子，铲猪粪。
他琢磨着，自己起早摸黑，辛苦养了两年的猪。
大伯就算不顾念骨肉亲情，看在功劳上，多少也会分自己两块肥肉解解馋吧。
所以今天二狗子也跟着开心不少。
今天注定是个收获的大喜日子，房间里的那几根禾苗，都已经成熟，稻穗沉甸甸的，颗粒饱满。
二狗子把这些谷子全都摘下，放在房间里晾干，打算留着做种子。
另外，偷偷种在山上的那一片禾苗，也已经抽穗，马上就可以收获了。
二狗子此时蹲在土灶边上烧火，锅里咕嘟咕嘟地冒着白气，一股诱人的肉香传出来，勾得他直吞口水。
此时堂兄端来一只大盘子，婶娘用筷子把锅里的肉一块块捞出来，放进盘子里。
那肥肉白白嫩嫩，跟豆腐花一样晃动，还直往外冒着油水，肉香味直往鼻孔里钻。
“够了！够了！”
眼看着木盘子里面的肉已经堆成了小山尖，堂哥连忙制止说是够了。

“孩啊，你多吃点，你们练武的饭量大，不吃饱哪里有力气！”
婶娘说着，又往盘子里加了几块大肥肉，压了压，压得油水直流。
“你们兄弟俩是全家的希望，以后要是能考个秀才或者举人，咱家可就飞黄腾达了！”
婶娘给堂兄装满一大盘肥肉之后，又开始捞出一块块肥肉往堂弟的盘子里装。
“娘，我想吃瘦肉！”
堂弟看着盘子里面流油的肥肉，竟然想吃瘦肉。
“你小孩子懂什么，肥肉多香呀，肥肉才是最好的肉，瘦肉是猪身上最贱的肉，又柴又没油水，还塞牙。”
“你看你长得瘦瘦弱弱，跟豆芽似的，就是要多吃肥肉才补。”
婶娘不管三七二十一，给堂弟捞了一大盘肥得流油的五花肉。
五花肉已经是她最大的让步了。
分完兄弟俩的肉，锅里只剩下一些排骨，筒子骨，精瘦肉这种肉了。
这些差一点的肉，就是留给他们老两口加上堂妹三个人吃的。
二狗子看着锅里剩下的骨头和瘦肉，自己想吃一块肥肉的梦想已经破灭了。
不过能吃到一块瘦肉，或者啃块骨头解解馋，也不错。
婶娘将锅里剩下的骨头和肉全都捞出来，看着锅里剩下的肉汤，上面还飘着许多油花。
“二狗子！”
“哎！婶娘！”
二狗子看着婶娘手里的猪肉，这一声应得极为响亮，脸上都挂满了灿烂的笑容，过年了就是要喜庆。
“你往锅里再兑些水，然后煮一大锅干野菜。”
“还有，地上那么多猪粪，你也不知道去清理一下！”

二狗子就这么眼巴巴地看着，婶娘把所有肉都端走了。
连一块骨头都没给他留，只给他留下一堆杂活。
唉！寄人篱下的人，永远别想吃上肉了。
content_en:
There is only one day left to celebrate the New Year. Probably to add some atmosphere to the New Year, it has been snowing heavily in the past two days, and the water has turned into ice.
Under the severe cold, those people in the village were lying in bed waiting to die. God didn't let them waste their meager rations, and three of them died in one day.
Families whose relatives had died simply gave a few perfunctory cries, then rolled them up with straw mats and buried them in mass graves.
The lives of the poor are cheap, just like weeds, they die every winter, and everyone has long been numb.
However, Uncle Ergouzi's family is enjoying themselves happily today.
My cousin who was studying martial arts in the county town came back, and the private school where my cousin went to school had already been on holiday.
The big black pig that Ergouzi had raised for two years finally died today and was killed for the Chinese New Year.
The pig's hair weighed 83 kilograms. After cleaning and scraping, there were still 50 kilograms of meat along with the internal organs, which was enough for the whole family to have a fat year.
Ergouzi didn't go to collect firewood anymore today, and kept busy, boiling water, shaving hair, turning intestines, and shoveling pig manure.
He thought about how he had worked so hard to raise pigs for two years after getting up early in the morning and working in the dark.
Even if the uncle doesn't care about his family ties, for the sake of his merits, he will still share his two pieces of fat to satisfy his craving.
So Ergouzi was also very happy today.
Today is destined to be a great day for harvesting. The few seedlings in the room are all mature, and the ears of rice are heavy and full of grains.
Ergouzi picked all the millet and put it in the room to dry, intending to keep it for making seeds.
In addition, the grass seedlings secretly planted on the mountain have also heading and will be harvested soon.
Ergouzi was squatting next to the earthen stove to light the fire. White steam was coming out of the pot, and an alluring aroma of meat came out, making him salivate.
At this time, the cousin brought a big plate, and the aunt used chopsticks to take out the meat in the pot piece by piece and put it on the plate.
The fat meat was white and tender, swaying like tofu pudding, oily and watery coming out, and the meaty aroma penetrated into the nostrils.
"That's enough! That's enough!"
Seeing that the meat in the wooden plate had piled up to the top of a hill, my cousin quickly stopped and said that it was enough.
"My child, you eat more. You eat a lot to practice martial arts. If you don't eat well, you won't have any strength!"
As the aunt said, she added a few more big pieces of fat meat to the plate and pressed it until the oil and water flowed.
"You two brothers are the hope of the whole family. If you can take the exam to become a scholar or a scholar in the future, our family will be prosperous!"
After the aunt filled a large plate of fat meat for her cousin, she began to take out pieces of fat meat and put them on his plate.
"Mom, I want to eat lean meat!"
The cousin looked at the oily fat meat on the plate and wanted to eat lean meat.
"What do you kids know? Fatty meat is so delicious. Fatty meat is the best meat. Lean meat is the cheapest meat from pigs. It's firewood, has no oil or water, and is stuffy to the teeth."
"Look, you are as thin and weak as a bean sprout. You just need to eat more fat to make up for it."
My aunt didn't care about anything and got a big plate of fat and oily pork belly for her cousin.
Pork belly was already her biggest concession.
After dividing the meat between the two brothers, there were only some pork ribs, tube bones, and lean meat left in the pot.
These little bits of meat were left for the old couple and their cousin to eat.
Ergouzi looked at the remaining bones and lean meat in the pot, and his dream of eating a piece of fat meat was shattered.
But it’s not bad to eat a piece of lean meat or gnaw on a bone to satisfy your craving.
The aunt took out all the bones and meat left in the pot and looked at the remaining broth in the pot, with many oily flowers floating on it.
"Er Gouzi!"
"Hey! Auntie!"
Er Gouzi looked at the pork in his aunt's hand, and he heard the sound of "yes" very loudly, with a bright smile on his face. The Chinese New Year is all about celebration.
"You add more water to the pot, and then cook a large pot of dried wild vegetables."
"Also, there is so much pig manure on the ground, and you don't even know how to clean it up!"
Ergouzi just watched helplessly, the aunt took all the meat away.
Not even a bone was left for him, only a pile of chores.
well! People who depend on others will never have the chance to eat meat.
